CREATE TABLE teacher_course_plan_notification_inbox (
    event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN ('course.plan.completed', 'course.plan.failed')),
    request_id UUID NOT NULL,
    causation_id UUID NOT NULL,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_id UUID,
    source_message_id UUID,
    teacher_decision_id UUID,
    status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED')),
    result_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    course_id UUID,
    reused BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    failure_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (source = 'TEACHER'),
    reason VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('INITIAL', 'REPLAN')),
    body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(body) <> '' AND char_length(body) <= 2000),
    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    dialog_message_id UUID,
    delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id) REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id),
    CHECK ((event_type = 'course.plan.completed') = (status = 'COMPLETED')),
    CHECK ((dialog_message_id IS NULL) = (delivered_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK (delivered_at IS NULL OR delivered_at >= accepted_at)
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_course_plan_notification_student_idx
    ON teacher_course_plan_notification_inbox (student_id, occurred_at DESC);
